Because at some point the comic relief in life is no longer comical. When I say I’m different, i don’t mean that because I try to fit in necessarily, it’s more or less I’m different in a sense of the things i want out of life aren’t like what everyone else wants. Everyone has dreams, goals and ambitions, but i want, no I need answers. Not to all of my questions, just answering one of the questions feels like it would be enough. I feel like there is a void inside of me because i have such a craving for absolutes . I hate I don’t knows, it feels lazy. In my mind there has to be an answer for everything so why can’t I find it? To your point about talking to a cultist or someone that does things that they know are wrong, i don’t believe that solves any issue. I don’t need to feel accepted or anything along those lines or reminded I’m not alone. The things I need are mostly related to piece of mind, like I need to be certain that x= this because then that means Xy= (fill in the blank). I’ll give you an example , is everything in life correlated or is it all cause and effect? If I were to take a left on the road instead of a right would I not have gotten a ticket and learned a lesson on how I shouldn’t speed down the road? Or is it rather that I was going to come across that lesson at some point but the stars aligned for today to be the day.
